verdict.line: You lose if you trade autos into an open Riposte or facecheck her double Lunge; you win if you land E first and snowball the stun into a Q reset.

brief.thesis: Irelia and Fiora are both melee dash-duelists whose damage lives in cooldowns rather than stat checks, and the 46.2% win rate over 1122 games says the deciding factor is engage discipline, not raw power. Fiora's W (Riposte) punishes any auto-attack-first trade by boosting her AD and reflecting the next basic hit, so the lane is won or lost on whether you engage with a spell (E) or with your hand on right-click.

theirWindow.when: Riposte is up, she Lunges (Q) in
theirWindow.what: She can bait an auto with the parry then follow the free second Lunge dash for a big burst-heal trade off her Duelist passive. Back off basic attacks and let the Riposte window (10/9/8/7/6s CD) expire before you commit.

yourWindow.when: Riposte on cooldown, you have 4 passive stacks
yourWindow.what: Open with E (Flawless Duet, 850 range) to stun and Mark her, then Q (Bladesurge) in — the Mark refreshes your Q cooldown instantly for a second strike and heal, and your maxed passive stacks add bonus on-hit damage to the combo.

start.why: The 47% win rate over 1150 games on this start exists because the lifesteal offsets Fiora's Duelist self-heal in extended trades — you need sustain parity, not burst, to survive to level 6.

boots.why: 89.2% pick and 47.6% win rate — flat physical reduction directly cuts the value of every auto Fiora lands to build her Duelist stacks.

core.why: Current-health damage plus the slow proc lets you punish her low-mobility windows after she burns both Lunge charges
Highest-winrate path (56% over 193 games) — scales your split-push threat once the lane stabilizes past level 11
Magic resist and attack speed keep your passive stacking online while denying her any hybrid poke

situational.when: you are behind on cooldowns and need to survive her all-in windows instead of racing damage
you are ahead after level 6 and want to close out fights before her Blade Waltz cooldown (130/120/110s) resets
her Duelist passive sustain is keeping her alive through your combos

runes.keystoneWhy: Both champions win through sustained skirmishing rather than one burst window, so the healing and adaptive force from stacked Conqueror directly counters her Duelist regen in prolonged trades.

summoners.why: The 88% pick rate reflects the matchup's kill pressure once you land E — Ignite shuts down her Duelist sustain heal exactly when you need the stun-to-Q burst to close.

playing.title: Engage with E, never with autos
playing.detail: Walking an auto into an up Riposte gives her bonus AD and a free reflected hit. Open trades with E (850 range) so the stun lands before she can react.

playing.title: Chain E into Q for the reset
playing.detail: Any target Marked by E refreshes Bladesurge's cooldown on hit, letting you dash-strike-heal twice in one trade window.

playing.title: Respect the double Lunge
playing.detail: Fiora can dash a second time within a couple seconds at no mana cost. If you dodge the first Q, hold position — the follow-up is still coming.

playing.title: Track your own 4-stack passive
playing.detail: Ionian Fervor caps for bonus on-hit damage at max stacks; delay your all-in a beat if you're one auto short of the cap.

playing.title: Charge W to eat her burst
playing.detail: Defiant Dance reduces physical damage taken while charging — hold it for her Blade Waltz (R) or a double-Lunge all-in rather than firing it early for poke.

playing.title: Don't chase past her E speed window
playing.detail: Burst of Speed stacks move speed on every landed attack or Lunge; if she's already popped it, you likely can't catch the kill — reset instead.

brief.patchCaveat: Build paths, runes, summoners, and the 46.2% head-to-head figure are measured from live OP.GG games on the current patch; the trade-pattern and cooldown-window reasoning above is my own read of the ability kits, not sourced data.

stats.opponentTip: Be caution of being hit with Fiora’s Reposte (W). Use [E] to engage when Irelia has 4 stacks [P] prepared while keeing her Reposte and Vitals in mind.
